topic: PrestaShop 1.6: before you start (backup and recompile setting)
queries: how do I set up sales tracking on PrestaShop 1.6
we're still on the older PrestaShop 1.6 does the setup differ
what do I do before editing PrestaShop files
content:
This guide covers manually installing KST on PrestaShop 1.6 or older. You will need to edit code.

Before starting:

- Get your merchantId and associated Country Code.
- Clean out any old Kelkoo tracking: search your code for `leadtag.js` and `_kkstrack`, and uninstall any Kelkoo plugin from your backend.
- **Back up** every file you are about to modify.
- Check the recompile option: go to **Advanced settings → Performance** and make sure "Recompile files of template if updated" is checked.

Note the 1.6 menu path is *Advanced settings*, whereas 1.7 and 8 use *Advanced parameters*.
section_heading: Before setting up your Kelkoo Sales Tracking Tag

topic: PrestaShop 1.6: install the Lead Tag in header.tpl
queries: where does the leadtag go in PrestaShop 1.6
add leadtag to old PrestaShop theme
content:
1. Open `themes/custom/header.tpl` — where `custom` is your template name, the default being "prestashop".
2. Add at the bottom of the file:

```
<script async="true" type="text/javascript" src="https://s.kk-resources.com/leadtag.js" ></script>
```

3. Clear the cache.

Note the file location differs from 1.7 and 8, which use `templates/_partials/head.tpl` instead.

topic: PrestaShop 1.7: install the Lead Tag in head.tpl
queries: where does the leadtag go in PrestaShop 1.7
content:
1. Open `themes//templates/_partials/head.tpl` — the documentation notes the theme folder is your template name, the default being "prestashop" (the published path shows an empty segment where that name belongs).
2. Add:

```
  <script async="true" type="text/javascript" src="https://s.kk-resources.com/leadtag.js" ></script>
```

3. Clear the cache: **Admin > Advanced Paramaters > Performance > Clear Cache**.

topic: PrestaShop 8: reinstall KST after a version or theme upgrade
queries: do I need to reinstall KST after upgrading PrestaShop
tracking stopped working after PrestaShop update
what happens to the tags when I upgrade
content:
KST must be reinstalled after any PrestaShop or theme upgrade.

Upgrades overwrite the controller and template files the tags live in, so a working installation can silently stop tracking after an update.
